description: Keyless DELAYED top-down macro context in one call: rate curve, dollar and credit, commodities, risk appetite and breadth, and cross-market indices, plus derived pairs (10Y-3M spread, copper/gold, HY/IG, equal-weight vs cap-weight). Use it to place a single name inside its macro environment. These are observations, not a regime call, and unavailable series are data gaps for open_questions.

blocks.description: Subset of macro blocks. Defaults to all.
